claimChecks.claim: Zimmer Skin Graft Mesher and MeshGraft II use the same grooved carrier face and ratio mechanism
claimChecks.locator: Manufacturer brochure mesher page; MeshGraft II manual pp. 1-3
claimChecks.note: Smooth/cutter for first model versus grooved/carrier for second; wrong MeshGraft II face can shred graft.

claimChecks.claim: All meshers require dermal-side-down graft and grooved-carrier petrolatum preparation
claimChecks.locator: MeshGraft II operating instructions p. 3; Herbert abstract Tanner method
claimChecks.note: MeshGraft II accepts epidermal or dermal side up by transfer workflow; Herbert is Tanner-specific.

claimChecks.claim: A labeled 3:1 carrier always has a 3:1 ridge pattern
claimChecks.locator: FDA recall Z-1078-2024 model and code information
claimChecks.note: Exact two affected lots and model recorded, not generalized to every carrier.

claimChecks.claim: Kan donor fractions and Henderson expansion are one clinical series directly applicable to GU beds
claimChecks.note: Kan clinical series and Henderson ex-vivo porcine study separated; genital transfer not validated.

claimChecks.claim: All Canadian burn surgeons cited burn size as the higher-mesh decision factor
claimChecks.note: 100% pertains to survey respondents who had ≥3:1 experience, not the national denominator.

claimChecks.claim: 1.5:1/2:1 is a universal scrotal and phalloplasty meshing protocol
claimChecks.locator: Original publisher-indexed scrotal STSG technique paragraph
claimChecks.note: Retained one team's 1.5:1 scrotal practice; device/GU-site-specific outcomes remain open.
